Product Details: Upgrade your toolbox with the Xtra Power HSS Step Drill Bit, a versatile drilling solution designed for precise hole-making across multiple diameters. This professional-grade step drill bit ranges from 4mm to 32mm, allowing you to create different sized holes without changing bits. Crafted from High-Speed Steel (HSS), it offers excellent durability and cutting performance across various materials. The stepped design reduces the need for multiple drill bits, saving both time and storage space. Its unique construction helps prevent walking or wandering when starting holes, whilst the fluted design efficiently clears away material during drilling. Perfect for metalworking, woodworking, and general construction tasks, this step drill bit proves invaluable for both professional contractors and DIY enthusiasts. The graduated steps are clearly marked for accurate hole sizing, making it an essential tool for precise drilling applications.
